verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a synchronous webhook for real-time authorization requests. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer receives and responds to. However, the evidence covers only this one authorization flow, not general subscription to Issuing events. Missing for 10: documentation of general event subscription/registration of webhook endpoints for Issuing events (cards, cardholders, disputes, transactions), event type catalog, signature verification/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Using the synchronous webhook, you can approve or decline authorization requests in real time.
